messages:
ben: quick q — prospect asked if we can exclude _their_ customer IDs from our request-log TTL so those customer logs are retained indefinitely. any red flags or formal process?
michelle_sec: short answer: we generally don’t do per-customer infinite retention. privacy + operational blast radius. need to know data type and legal basis. :eyes:
ben: they said it's for audit purposes in their regulated workflow. they provided a PO and a contract clause that implies longer retention for a named customer.
james_devops: technically we could create an S3 lifecycle exception or tag objects for a longer TTL, but that adds complexity to lifecycle rules and cost. also increases egress/backup surface.
michelle_sec: also compliance view: if it's PII, we need Data Subject processing agreement + formal exception logged. runbook says exceptions require a ticket with legal + sec approval.
sam_legal: confirm — we can consider an exception but need: (1) contract amendment, (2) written justification, (3) expiration / review cadence. indefinite is risky; recommend 7 years max, with review.
anna_prod: from product/ops side: if we implement a per-customer retention tag it must be limited to Dedicated/Private customers only. Hosted customers share buckets and we avoid per-tenant permanent retention there.
ben: noted. customer is talking to sales about Dedicated. they asked for the engineering feasibility first.
michelle_sec: ops checklist: 1) record exception in retention-exceptions spreadsheet, 2) create ticket referencing contract clause, 3) sec + legal sign-off, 4) label bucket/objects with `retain:customer-<id>` and add lifecycle rule `NoncurrentKeep`.
james_devops: sample lifecycle snippet (draft):
```
{
  "Rules": [
    {
      "ID": "retain-customer-12345",
      "Filter": { "Tag": { "Key": "retain", "Value": "customer-12345" }},
      "Status": "Enabled",
      "Expiration": { "Days": 3650 }
    }
  ]
}
```
james_devops: that sets 10y (3650 days). we should avoid "never". Also must ensure backups/snapshots inherit tag or we have a process to re-tag.
michelle_sec: also add audit log entry and submit a short migration plan: how to tag existing objects if they need backfill. backfilling could be heavy.
sam_legal: approved workflow: contract amendment -> legal ticket -> sec review -> exec sign-off if >5y retention. I can draft contract clause language.
retention-bot: reminder: add retention-exceptions/<ticket-id> entry within 24h of approval. :robot_face:
ben: action items: i'll ask sales to get contract amendment, i'll open infra ticket for tagging/backfill with `P0` label after legal ok. thanks all.
anna_prod: ping me once sales confirms, i'll add a runbook snippet to docs and flag Dedicated-only in the notes. :thumbsup:
michelle_sec: TL;DR: not a hard no, needs legal + sec + ops workflow; avoid indefinite retention; prefer bounded period with review.
ben: thanks — filed internal ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFRA-7421 (will update thread when legal chimes in)
